### Survival likelihood contributions, assuming non-informative censoring

$$
\ba
\p(Y=y,D=d)
&= [\pdf_T(y)]^{d} [\surv_T(y)]^{1-d}
\\
&= [\haz_T(y)]^{d} [\surv_T(y)]
\ea
$$

### Proportional hazards model structure

| Formula | Description |
|:--------|:------------|
| $\haz(t\mid\vx) = \haz_0(t)\cdot\hazfactor(\vx)$ | [Proportional hazards assumption](proportional-hazards-models.qmd#def-pha) |
| $\cuhaz(t\mid\vx) = \cuhaz_0(t)\cdot\hazfactor(\vx)$ | [Cumulative hazard factorization](proportional-hazards-models.qmd#thm-ph-cuhaz) |
| $\loghaz(t\mid\vx) = \loghaz_0(t) + \Delta\eta(\vx)$ | [Log-hazard decomposition](proportional-hazards-models.qmd#thm-loghaz-decomp) |
| $\Delta\eta(\vx) = \dprod{\vx}{\vb} = \beta_1 x_1 + \cdots + \beta_p x_p$ | [Linear predictor](Intro-to-GLMs.qmd#def-linear-predictor) |
| $\hazfactor(\vx) = \expf{\Delta\eta(\vx)}$ | [Hazard multiplier](proportional-hazards-models.qmd#def-risk-score) |
| $\defHR$ | [Hazard ratio definition](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-hazard-ratio) |
| $\hr(t\mid\vx:\vxs) = \expf{\Delta\eta(\vx) - \Delta\eta(\vxs)} = \expf{\dprod{(\vx-\vxs)}{\vb}}$ | [Hazard ratio formula](proportional-hazards-models.qmd#thm-hazard-ratio-ph) |
